package pedagogy

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type LessonContext struct {
	Targets                []domain.TargetRef
	TransitionKnowledge    []domain.TransitionKnowledge
	SelfAssessedExperience string
}

type Strategy interface {
	Code() string
	Applies(LessonContext, json.RawMessage) (bool, error)
}

type Registry struct {
	strategies map[string]Strategy
}

func NewRegistry(strategies ...Strategy) (Registry, error) {
	registry := Registry{strategies: make(map[string]Strategy, len(strategies))}
	for _, strategy := range strategies {
		if strategy == nil || strategy.Code() == "" {
			return Registry{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := registry.strategies[strategy.Code()]; duplicate {
			return Registry{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		registry.strategies[strategy.Code()] = strategy
	}
	if len(registry.strategies) == 0 {
		return Registry{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return registry, nil
}

func NewDefaultRegistry() Registry {
	strategies := []Strategy{
		conditionalStrategy{code: "explicit_instruction", condition: always},
		conditionalStrategy{code: "retrieval_practice", condition: always},
		conditionalStrategy{code: "prior_knowledge_bridge", condition: hasTransition},
		conditionalStrategy{code: "compare_contrast", condition: hasTransition},
	}
	registry := Registry{strategies: make(map[string]Strategy, len(strategies))}
	for _, strategy := range strategies {
		registry.strategies[strategy.Code()] = strategy
	}
	return registry
}

func (registry Registry) Select(
	configured []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion,
	context LessonContext,
) ([]domain.PedagogyStrategyRef, error) {
	if len(registry.strategies) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]domain.PedagogyStrategyRef, 0, len(configured))
	for _, version := range configured {
		strategy, exists := registry.strategies[version.Code]
		if !exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		applies, err := strategy.Applies(context, version.Config)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if applies {
			result = append(result, domain.PedagogyStrategyRef{Code: version.Code, Version: version.Version})
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

type conditionalStrategy struct {
	code      string
	condition func(LessonContext) bool
}

func (strategy conditionalStrategy) Code() string { return strategy.code }

func (strategy conditionalStrategy) Applies(context LessonContext, config json.RawMessage) (bool, error) {
	var object map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(config, &object); err != nil || object == nil {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return strategy.condition(context), nil
}

func always(LessonContext) bool { return true }

func hasTransition(context LessonContext) bool { return len(context.TransitionKnowledge) > 0 }
